name: Leaf - A Modern, Sustainable LLM Interface
tagline: Routes each prompt to the smallest effective model to save energy and keep quality.
problem: Heavy AI agents are used for simple prompts, wasting energy.
solution: Scores prompt difficulty, answers directly or breaks it into subtasks for smaller models, with environmental data.
demo_moment: Team-described: a simple prompt avoids the large model.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Makes efficiency a feature of the interface.

lessons: Right-size the model to the task.
